properties.entry: SELECT C.CATEGORY_NAME, NVL(SUM(T.TRANS_AMOUNT), 0) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM GROUP_TRANSACTIONS T JOIN GROUP_CATEGORIES C ON T.GCATEGORY_NUM = C.GCATEGORY_NUM WHERE T.GROUP_NUM IN ( SELECT GROUP_NUM FROM GROUP_MEMBERS WHERE USER_NUM = ? AND MEMBER_STATUS = 'A' ) AND TO_CHAR(T.TRANS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') = ? AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY C.CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_AMOUNT DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(T.TRANS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') AS TARGET_MONTH, NVL(SUM(T.TRANS_AMOUNT), 0) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM GROUP_TRANSACTIONS T WHERE T.GROUP_NUM IN ( SELECT GROUP_NUM FROM GROUP_MEMBERS WHERE USER_NUM = ? AND MEMBER_STATUS = 'A' ) AND T.TRANS_DATE >= ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(?, 'YYYY-MM'), -5) AND T.TRANS_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(?, 'YYYY-MM'), 1) AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(T.TRANS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY TARGET_MONTH

INSERT INTO GROUP_TRANSACTIONS ( GTRANS_NUM, GROUP_NUM, PERIOD_NUM, GCATEGORY_NUM, USER_NUM, TRANS_AMOUNT, TRANS_DATE, TRANS_MEMO, USE_YN, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_GROUP_TRANSACTIONS.NEXTVAL, ?, (SELECT MAX(PERIOD_NUM) FROM LEDGER_PERIODS WHERE GROUP_NUM = ? AND PERIOD_STATUS = 'O'), ?, ?, ?, TO_DATE(?, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ?, 'Y', SYSDATE )
SELECT T.*, C.CATEGORY_NAME FROM GROUP_TRANSACTIONS T JOIN GROUP_CATEGORIES C ON T.GCATEGORY_NUM = C.GCATEGORY_NUM WHERE T.GTRANS_NUM = ?
UPDATE GROUP_TRANSACTIONS SET GCATEGORY_NUM = ?, TRANS_AMOUNT = ?, TRANS_DATE = TO_DATE(?, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TRANS_MEMO = ? WHERE GTRANS_NUM = ?
UPDATE GROUP_TRANSACTIONS SET USE_YN = 'N' WHERE GTRANS_NUM = ?

INSERT INTO EXPENSE_LOGS ( LOG_NUM, GTRANS_NUM, ACTION_USER_NUM, ACTION_TYPE, BEFORE_AMOUNT, AFTER_AMOUNT, BEFORE_CATEGORY, AFTER_CATEGORY, CREATED_AT ) VALUES (SEQ_EXPENSE_LOGS.NEXTVAL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, SYSDATE)
